chapter.heading: A Psalm of Exodus
chapter.v:
When Israel
departed from Egypt,the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

Judah became
God’s sanctuary,and Israel His dominion.

The sea
observed and fled;the Jordan turned back;

the mountains
skipped like rams,the hills like lambs.

Why was
it, O sea, that you fled,O Jordan, that you turned back,

O mountains,
that you skipped like rams,O hills, like lambs?

Tremble, O
earth, at the presence of the Lord,at the presence of the God of Jacob,

who turned
the rock into a pool,the flint into a fountain of water!
